device.name: SmartThings Hub v2
device.notes: SmartThings Hub v2 advertises local SmartThings, Edge driver, and Matter bridge services via mDNS. The primary identity is the _smartthings._tcp TXT id value. _smartthings-hedge._tcp on port 8766 exposes Edge driver control features, and _matter._tcp advertises the Matter bridge endpoint.

factory_reset.effect: Unclaims the hub and clears its ZigBee/Z-Wave networks; every paired radio device must be re-joined afterwards.

procedures.indicator: Status LED turns yellow and flashes.
procedures.name: Reset button held while powering on

steps.action: Hold the recessed reset button on the back while restoring power, and keep holding until the LED flashes yellow.
steps.notes: Vendor-documented; verify before use — this drops every paired ZigBee and Z-Wave device.

methods.description: Ethernet to the router; the hub takes a DHCP lease and advertises _smartthings._tcp.local.

steps.action: Connect Ethernet, insert the batteries if fitted, and apply power.
steps.expect: Status LED settles to solid green once the hub reaches the service.

cloud.local_alternative: None known. Edge drivers execute locally once installed, but the claim step and driver distribution both require the cloud.

methods.description: The welcome code on the hub is redeemed in the vendor app, which binds the hub to a Samsung account and provisions its drivers.

steps.action: Redeem the welcome code printed on the underside of the hub in the vendor app.

setup.notes: The hub is Ethernet-only and its onboarding is entirely cloud-mediated: the welcome code printed on the underside is redeemed against Samsung's service, and the hub receives its identity and driver set from there. Local Edge drivers run on the hub afterwards, but there is no documented way to claim an unclaimed hub without the cloud, which is the key risk if the service is retired.

rejoin.notes: Moving the hub to a different router is a cable move; the cloud claim is unaffected.

http_endpoints.description: Primary _smartthings._tcp service endpoint on port 8081. Edge control is advertised separately on the hedge WebSocket service.
http_endpoints.name: SmartThings Local Service Root
